a.lede: Dozens of shops across European countries have been hit by a cyber-attack affecting their fridges.
a.title: If hackers can take control of a supermarket freezer, how vulnerable is other tech?

b.lede: Following the string of cyberattacks on supermarket freezers, blood banks in France were recently attacked. Luckily, no biomaterial was lost as the attack triggered the EFS' alerts.
b.title: Hackers target French blood service fridges following supermarket attacks
